feature_requests.text: App is good but needs average NAV feature for mutual funds to track performance better. Would help with SIP tracking.
Can't modify orders after placement, this is very frustrating for active traders. Please add order modification within 5 minutes.
Need trailing stop loss for US stocks. Feature request from long time user.

bug_fixes.text: UI is confusing, hard to find mutual fund section and track investments. Great app otherwise.
Fractional shares limit order does not work. It resets every time I try to set limit price for dollar amount.
Lost money due to multiple failed transactions. Order execution is unreliable during market hours.
Fund tracking is broken. Shows wrong NAV and P&L. Please fix data sync issues.

ui_ux.text: Technical chart was better before. The new chart is not as user friendly as TradingView.
Love the flash trading feature. App is faster now. Good job team.
Best investment app for NRIs. Simple and straightforward. Minor UI tweaks needed.
